name: Trigger.dev
tagline: Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for running background jobs, scheduled tasks, and long-running AI workflows in serverless environments. It provides a TypeScript SDK with automatic retries, step functions, and real-time execution monitoring for reliable async processing.
